title: CF Meet delegated platform context v1
description: Safe customer/application/actor identifiers an authenticated backend service asserts on behalf of the request it is serving. Carried only inside a signed service token. Contains identifiers only: never credentials, verifiers, Authorization headers, telephone numbers, protected contact data, passwords, session cookies, provider secrets or consumer business payloads. Receivers treat it as an assertion by the authenticated issuer, not as customer authentication.

initiating_credential_id.description: Platform Access id (never a secret) of the API credential the API Gateway authenticated. Receivers re-verify it with Platform Access so revocation, expiry and effective scopes are evaluated live.
